title: Brazilian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful wrap filled with grilled chicken, gooey cheese, and zesty sauce, inspired by Brazilian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Zesty sauce
ingredients.notes: such as salsa or hot sauce

ingredients.name: Brazilian seasoning
ingredients.notes: such as cumin, coriander, or paprika

instructions: Season chicken breast with Brazilian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add gooey cheese to the pan and stir until melted.
Warm wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing grilled chicken, gooey cheese, and zesty sauce inside.
